# vappcloud_vmm (Resource)

A Terraform-managed secondary VMM. The system-managed default VMM is read-only and is available through VMM data sources; it cannot be created, adopted, imported, or destroyed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_device" "host" {
  project_id = vappcloud_project.example.id
  name       = "worker-1"
}

resource "vappcloud_vmm" "secondary" {
  project_id          = vappcloud_project.example.id
  device_id           = vappcloud_device.host.id
  name                = "application-pool"
  cpu_cores           = 4
  memory_mb           = 8192
  deletion_protection = true
  retain_disk         = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Desired virtual CPU cores.
- `device_id` (String) Immutable host device ID.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Desired memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) VMM name.
- `project_id` (String) Immutable owning project ID.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) API-enforced deletion protection.
- `retain_disk` (Boolean) Preserve the root disk as an auditable retained-storage record when the VMM is deleted.

### Read-Only

- `correlation_id` (String) Latest operation correlation ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `desired_revision` (Number) Desired VMM specification revision.
- `disk_mb` (Number) Root disk capacity in MiB.
- `health` (String) Agent-reported health.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Always false for managed resources.
- `management` (String) Management owner: terraform, console, external, or system.
- `observed_revision` (Number) Latest agent-observed revision.
- `operation_id` (String) Latest asynchronous operation ID.
- `operation_status` (String) Latest asynchronous operation state.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `state` (String) Runtime state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.
